purpose: Assign business priority, technical criticality, and dependency-safe execution sequencing to distinct owners with no generic priority compatibility surface.
rules: Nomia is the only writer of business_priority.
Mago is the only writer of technical_criticality and execution_sequence.
Magia consumes priority-related planning fields as read-only execution inputs.
Business priority never determines technical criticality.
Mapping guidance is advisory and never an automatic enum conversion.
Mago may choose an execution lane or rank only with planning rationale and dependency evidence.
Dependency topology, safety controls, validation, and rollback override suggested lanes.
A non-unknown business priority projection requires Nomia provenance and observation time.
The generic fields priority and order_hint are unsupported and must be rejected by every package.

compatibility.migration_policy: Records using rejected fields must be migrated outside runtime validation before use; no package performs implicit conversion.
